test_cases.description: getQuote returns complete QuoteBreakdown for a valid 3-night stay with base rate, one flat fee, one percentage fee, one tax, and a qualifying LOS discount

mock_dependencies.pricing_schema.resolveRatesForDateRange: returns 3 nightly rates at 10000 cents each

test_cases.input_description: unitId=valid UUID, checkIn=2024-06-01, checkOut=2024-06-04, currency=USD
test_cases.expected_output_description: ServiceResultOk with QuoteBreakdown containing 3 nightly rates, subtotal, LOS discount, fees, taxes, and grandTotal

test_cases.description: getQuote QuoteBreakdown satisfies all arithmetic invariants: nightlySubtotal == sum(rates), grandTotal == discountedSubtotal + feesTotal + taxesTotal

mock_dependencies.pricing_schema.listFeesByUnit: returns one FLAT fee 2500 cents taxable, one PERCENTAGE fee 500bp non-taxable

test_cases.input_description: unitId=valid UUID, checkIn=2024-06-01, checkOut=2024-06-04, currency=USD, with fees, taxes, and LOS discount
test_cases.expected_output_description: QuoteBreakdown where all arithmetic relationships hold exactly
assertions: result['value']['nightlySubtotal'] == sum(r['rate'] for r in result['value']['nightlyRates'])
result['value']['feesTotal'] == sum(f['resolvedAmount'] for f in result['value']['fees'])
result['value']['taxesTotal'] == sum(t['taxAmount'] for t in result['value']['taxes'])

test_cases.description: All CentsAmount fields in QuoteBreakdown are non-negative integers
test_cases.input_description: unitId=valid UUID, checkIn=2024-06-01, checkOut=2024-06-04, currency=USD
test_cases.expected_output_description: All monetary fields >= 0 and are integers
assertions: all(isinstance(r['rate'], int) and r['rate'] >= 0 for r in result['value']['nightlyRates'])

test_cases.description: Only the single best (highest discount %) qualifying LOS discount is applied

test_cases.expected_output_description: losDiscount uses the 1000bp discount (higher), not the 500bp one

test_cases.description: taxableAmount equals discountedSubtotal plus sum of taxable fee amounts only

mock_dependencies.pricing_schema.listFeesByUnit: returns one taxable FLAT 2500c, one non-taxable PERCENTAGE 500bp

test_cases.input_description: unitId with one taxable flat fee (2500c) and one non-taxable percentage fee
test_cases.expected_output_description: taxableAmount == discountedSubtotal + taxable_fee_amount, excludes non-taxable fee
assertions: taxable_fee_sum == sum(f['resolvedAmount'] for f in result['value']['fees'] if f['isTaxable'])

test_cases.description: ServiceResult always has exactly one of value or error set, never both, never neither
test_cases.input_description: Both success and error scenarios
test_cases.expected_output_description: ok=True implies value is not None and error is None; ok=False implies value is None and error is not None
assertions: (result['ok'] is True and result['value'] is not None and result['error'] is None) or (result['ok'] is False and result['value'] is None and result['error'] is not None)
